name: Alexander Campos
description: Builds software, works in operations, and writes about the systems people depend on. Research interests include compute economics, ownership, and individual agency. Background includes six years in regulated finance.

products.name: ForgeFrame
products.description: Open-source agent memory over MCP, using SQLite and FTS5. Supports retrieval, use-based strengthening, decay, and protected principles.

products.name: CREATURE
products.description: A personal agent system running on one machine: memory, model routing, scheduled jobs, and approval queues. An experiment in making context, permissions, and failures inspectable.

products.name: Reframed
products.description: A live resume tool with several analytical perspectives and signed records of text changes. Its receipts document editing; they do not prove a claim is true.

products.name: DEUCE
products.description: A tennis forecasting experiment that signs forecasts before outcomes are known so calibration can be evaluated. Paper only; no capital at risk.
